concepts.name: dust-bunny
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one boss concept for Enter the Fluffy, a cute-creepy pixel-art bullet-hell. Floor: Under the Bed, a dusty kingdom of lost bedroom things. PRIORITY: DRAW THE VISUAL JOKE described below; the household material and absurd behavior must read immediately, not merely an animal wearing accessories. Halloween plush horror icon: scary silhouette, huggable materials, funny details, menacing pose, not babyish. Single character full body centered, front-facing three-quarter standing view, fills frame with comfortable margins, plain warm off-white background. Chunky low-resolution pixel art, thick dark plum #211827 outline, hard pixel edges, flat colors, simple two-tone shading, restricted 10–14-color palette, silhouette readable at 64x64. No text, labels, watermark, extra characters, gradients, photorealism, gore, papier-mache texture or generic grey lumpy blob. Accent color clearly visible at least twice.
THE DUST BUNNY. Visual joke: a nightmare rabbit you could still vacuum up. Its anatomy is unmistakably an accumulation of loose under-bed dust and lint, not a real furry rabbit. Huge hunched wardrobe-sized rabbit silhouette made of soft scalloped grey-mauve dusty fluff with loose clumps floating from shoulders, dust visibly shedding and a faint wheezing dust cone from its grin. Long tattered ears, left ear snapped halfway and bent, spiderweb between ears. Fixed unsettling grin, two square buck teeth with underbite, button nose, deep black sockets with tiny amber #ffd886 pupils, six crooked wire-thin whiskers. Long hanging paws; dusty pink #d3b7cb inner ears, paws and belly patch. Body #6d5f72, highlight #b9a7bb, shadow #463b4d. Keep shedding dust and cobweb more legible than fur detail. One boss only, omit baby kit to obey single-character composition.

THE MONSTER UNDER THE BED. Visual joke: every kid's fear, but it's doing its own laundry cosplay. A stolen bedsheet obviously MUCH too small, stretched awkwardly over a tall monster, ghost costume failing to conceal FOUR long floppy mitten arms and two enormous three-toed monster feet. One hand visibly tugs down the short sheet hem like someone embarrassed their costume doesn't fit; another grips an edge like a theatrical cape. Crisp freshly folded laundry creases, big stitches on seams; nervous oval eye holes showing white eyes with tiny amber #ffd886 pupils, one real claw tip poking through a chewed hole beside face. Soft shadow pool beneath. Sheet lavender #cfc2d6, shadows #9a8aa6, inner dark #4a3a56; seam pink #edccc9 prominently on hem and chunky stitches. The obvious ill-fitting domestic bedsheet is the main visual gag, not a normal ghost.
